text: あなた　ごしゅみは…？
note: "ごしゅみは？" is the stock question asked at an omiai, a formal meeting between prospective marriage partners. The English game replaced it with "Pleased to meet you."
claim: "ご趣味は？" (What are your hobbies?) is a stock question at a Japanese omiai, a formal marriage meeting.

check.quote: お見合いといえば『ご趣味は？』という質問が思い浮かびますが
